## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.
# Assignment
# Target
Write `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/plans/round-64-controls.sh` — the pre-freeze control battery carrying the recursion-bound refutation control plus the no-work and stub controls — and add the `R63_CONTROLS_FIXTURE_ONLY` branch to `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/plans/round-63-controls.sh` if the C2 seat has not. You own those two files plus your receipts.

# Change
Read `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/plans/round-64.md` §C1/§C2 and `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/plans/round-63-controls.sh` (590 lines; per-control line `CONTROL <id> expect=… observed=… verdict=match|mismatch|skip`).
Write `plans/round-64-controls.sh` with the same shape and a fixture-driven `--selftest` (no lane instruments required, no `bao`). It takes a tree argument, prints `CONTROLS: match=N mismatch=M`, exit 0 iff mismatch=0, 1 on a mismatch, 2 SETUP. Controls:
- `C1-F9` — a printer-stub copy of `plans/round-64-c1.sh` (prints `C1_HELDOUT: heldout=0 population=8 guard=1 …`, exits 0) on the tree must read `mismatch` against the expected BASE line `heldout=8`.
- `C2-F7` — a constant-verdict copy of `plans/round-64-c2.sh` (prints `C2_REFUSAL: killed=5 population=5 guard=1 … terminates=1`, exits 0) must read `mismatch` against the expected BASE line `terminates=0`.
- `C2-BOUND` — the refutation leg: with `C2_RECURSION_BOUND=0` and `timeout 240`, `plans/round-64-c2.sh` must NOT terminate (no verdict line); a run that terminates under the bound reads `mismatch`. This control is what makes the bound non-decorative.
- `C1-NOWORK` / `C2-NOWORK` — the unmutated counters on a BASE tree must read `heldout=8` / `terminates=0` (the no-work controls).
- `C1-REAL` / `C2-REAL` — the unmutated counters on the candidate must print their verdict lines with `guard=1`.
- the round-63 battery's own controls re-run as `PRIOR-<id>` rows (delegate to `plans/round-63-controls.sh --selftest`, re-emit each verdict).
`--selftest` must be fixture-driven: build stub counters and stub trees under your scratch and assert each control's expected verdict, with a named `FINDING R64C-CTL-ST-<case>` line and exit 1 on a failing case. Record the battery's BASE reading in `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-64/build/R64ExecControls/controls.md` with every command and output.

# Acceptance
`bash plans/round-64-controls.sh <BASE tree>` prints `CONTROLS: match=N mismatch=M` with `C1-F9`/`C2-F7`/`C2-BOUND` reading `mismatch` on a stub/full-battery tree and the no-work controls reading `match`; `bash plans/round-64-controls.sh --selftest` prints `CONTROLS_SELFTEST: PASS (cases=N)`; `controls.md` records every command and output. End with `SEAT-STATUS: complete` or `SEAT-STATUS: partial <reason>`.
